title: Burn the boats to win
hook: Sometimes the strongest move is deleting your own way out.
caption: Sometimes the strongest move is deleting your own way out. A commitment strategy limits your options so your threat or promise is believable (Schelling 1960).

headline: BURN
THE
BOATS.

scenes.say: Sometimes the strongest move is deleting your own way out.
A commitment strategy: limit your own options so your promise or threat becomes believable.
Cut the escape route, the other side believes you won't back down, and they adjust.
Generals have burned their own ships so the army knew there was no way home.
In game theory, fewer options can be an advantage, because others are forced to believe you.
Want to keep a hard decision? Make quitting expensive before you start.

takeaway: Want to keep a hard decision? Make quitting expensive before you start.
